candidate: Sify Airoli Data Center (MUM02), Reliable Plaza, Plot K-10, Kalwa Industrial Estate, Airoli, Navi Mumbai: MIDC plot-centroid locator (new site)

source.service: MIDC CitizenPortal/MIDC_Main_Map_Service MapServer layer 11 'Plot Boundary' (gis.midcindia.org), query IA_CODE=201 AND PLOT_NUMBER='KALWA-K-10', fields limited to plot identifiers, area, published centroid, allotment status and land use (no user or editor fields requested)
source.statement: One feature: OBJECTID 271823, IA_NAME 'Trans Thane Creek Industrial Area', IA_CODE 201, PLOT_NUMBER 'KALWA-K-10', MIDC_PLOT_AREA 19670.0, LONGITUDE 73.00013538 and LATITUDE 19.16940396 (field aliases 'Longitude (X Coordinate of Plot Centroid)' and 'Latitude (Y Coordinate of Plot Centroid)'), ALLOTED_STATUS_TYPE 2 (ALLOTED), MIDC_LAND_USE 1 (Industrial), one ring of 24 vertices in EPSG:32643.

native_ring.crs: EPSG:32643 WGS 84 / UTM zone 43N (response spatialReference wkid 32643)

transformation.operation: Inverse of UTM zone 43N on WGS 84 (no datum change), used only to check the published centroid

selected_point_basis: The plot centroid MIDC publishes in the record's LONGITUDE and LATITUDE fields, retained unchanged (direct geometry).

checks.uniqueness: Query PLOT_NUMBER LIKE '%K-10%' across all MIDC industrial areas (midc-plot-k10-search.json, sha256 c39a355dc62c32fab15095f5738a4b7ddcc1d28b4d3901147ab24756d913f13d) returns, in the Trans Thane Creek Industrial Area (IA_CODE 201), only KALWA-K-10 (19,670 m2, allotted, industrial) and PAP-K-10 (90 m2, land use 31 'Amenity PAP', about 0.9 km to the north); every other match lies in another MIDC industrial area (for example Taloja, Tarapur, Murbad, Mahad, Satara, Nashik-Ambad, Jalgaon, Akola, Nagpur and Aurangabad).
checks.neighbouring_plots: A 250 m buffer query around the selected point (midc-plots-near-kalwa-k-10.json, sha256 dfd2ee4d4f2e9c019977033641fd0cc8a0c7730d4c7589674777cb318f4f409c) lists KALWA-K-10, KALWA-K-7/AND 7A (25,212 m2, allotted, about 140 m to the south), a 24 m2 commercial plot P-143 and three encroachment parcels; none is attributed to Sify by any source used.
checks.operator_factsheet_coordinate: Sify's MUM02 (Airoli) factsheet (sify-mum02-airoli-factsheet.pdf, sha256 18fdd70824d1c5d2903c5a71c25bf205d22ce09e101e48fd55e788c37032e500) prints '19.1692942 E ,72.9976491 N' under the Reliable Plaza address (the hemisphere letters are transposed). That point lies 261.8 m from the selected centroid and 182.6 m outside the plot ring, west of the railway in an electrical switchyard on Esri imagery, and a 150 m buffer query around it (midc-plots-near-sify-factsheet-point.json, sha256 b6525a4962722b2e993748212290c4d73f76654c180e4a8bc34b092d01b20735) returns no MIDC plot. It is recorded as a discrepancy and not used.
checks.operator_address: Sify's Mumbai page (version 2026-09-29, sify-mumbai-data-center.html, sha256 68f27260663921a43e70b864520cb864070494452d44392c494c28f6b7838be1) gives the Airoli Data Center location as '6th floor, Reliable Plaza, Plot No:- K-10, Kalwa Industrial Estate, City: Airoli Navi Mumbai - Post code: 400708'; the MUM02 factsheet repeats 'Reliable Plaza, Plot No:- K-10, Kalwa Industrial Estate, Airoli Navi Mumbai- 400710'.
checks.imagery_visual_check: Esri World Imagery export (esri-imagery-airoli-k10.png, sha256 7bc3d97babd5b20418b8d74a4462ef9b2608d19352c11f7f7b6477c7e110e1e4; visual check only, not a locator source): the plot ring encloses two large multi-storey buildings east of the Thane-Belapur road and the railway; the western building carries dense rooftop plant consistent with data-centre cooling. Imagery date not stated.
checks.atlas_records_within_2km: Checked against verified_construction_core/2026-11-07-research-hundredtwentyfourth, every pending queue changes.json and claims.tsv: CapitaLand DC Navi Mumbai Campus (Mumbai 01, Airoli; another operator) 705 m north; Digital Edge Navi Mumbai Campus (and in-west-north-p1 BOM1/BOM3 at its reused point) 1,875 m. Sify Rabale data center campus (imported locality point) is 2,944 m away; the true Rabale campus (Plot R-847, TTC) is a separate Sify site.
